primary_hypothesis: R3-H1 paired DEM-normal scarp profile; band 12 detrended elevation and band 19 slope
spatial_layout: same as R2: four contiguous quadrants; original 8-connected catalogue components assigned by majority eligible quadrant; include all held component tails in evaluation; 80 px Euclidean train/evaluation buffer

feature.name: paired_scarp_profile
feature.sample_method: bilinear along local DEM-gradient unit normal

negative_definition: held-out catalogue-zero proxy, excluding the 3 px known-label collar; not field-verified absence

placement.fold_budget_rule: round(37654 * eligible evaluation-region pixels / eligible footprint pixels)
placement.candidate_pool: eligible fold region, minus visible catalogue components
placement.emitter: registered R2 incremental triangular-kernel max-cover greedy, fixed pool rule; same for both arms

independence_gate.abandon_exchange_if: any registered correlation is undefined, fewer than 20 usable blocks, or any absolute correlation >= 0.60
independence_gate.proxy_caveat: low proxy-negative error correlation does not prove conditional independence or view sufficiency

optional_cotraining_trial.direction: only confident donor and receiver abstains
